summary.text: Applied the published v0.5.70 AI Cockpit installer on the dedicated branch, then restored and verified adopter-specific governance behavior.

mechanism.text: Compared template main, published v0.5.70, and installed catalog/runtime surfaces; preserved explicit conflict decisions and validated the result with regression and governance gates.

affectedComponents.detail: Updated managed .ai, scripts, Makefiles, and documentation surfaces.

designDecisions.decision: Install published v0.5.70 and compare main separately
designDecisions.reason: The repository workflow requires a published immutable release for adopter upgrades while main is the requested comparison baseline.
